FastAPI listens on 127.0.0.1:8000 and Streamlit listens on 127.0.0.1:8501. Nginx listens publicly on port 80. Requests to /api/ are proxied to FastAPI. Requests to / are proxied to Streamlit. The intended storage root on EC2 is /opt/agentic-crag/data. The environment file should live at /opt/agentic-crag/.env. The repository should be cloned to /opt/agentic-crag/app. The systemd services expect the virtual environment at /opt/agentic-crag/app/venv. Security Group Rules Inbound SSH on port 22 should be restricted to the developer current public IPv4 address using a /32 source rule. Inbound HTTP on port 80 may be opened to 0.0.0.0/0 for a temporary demo, but the instance should be stopped or locked down after use. The EC2 instance should not expose FastAPI port 8000 or Streamlit port 8501 directly to the public internet. Nginx should be the public entry point. For a longer-lived deployment, add HTTPS, a domain name, and authentication before sharing the application broadly. Setup Commands The recommended initial package command is: sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y python3 python3-venv nginx git. A small instance may need a swap file. The demo runbook uses a 2 GB swap file at /swapfile to reduce dependency installation failures. After cloning the repository, run bash deploy/setup_ec2.sh from /opt/agentic-crag/app for repeatable setup. After editing /opt/agentic-crag/.env, restart the application services with sudo systemctl restart agentic-crag-api agentic-crag-ui. Health Checks The backend direct health check is curl http://127.0.0.1:8000/health. The Nginx-routed health check is curl http://127.0.0.1/api/health.
